API Reference

Public Python interfaces for launching Proffer and extending its signal-processing pipeline.

Proffer exposes a compact functional API. Select a section to view its interfaces, requirements, and focused examples.

Application

Launch Proffer and configure its workspace and processing pipeline.

Data

Load external signals into a validated channel-first representation.

Features

Define numeric features and assemble reusable feature sets.

Algorithms

Register custom window-level detection methods.

Pipeline Configuration

Select algorithms, bind feature sets, and configure window sizes.

Runtime Contexts

Access prepared inputs and processing metadata inside extensions.

Extension model: define a module-level function, pass or register it, then run Proffer. Decorators and JSON registration files are not required.
